title: Make the feature map read-first in doctrine and give the drive its home on the cap proof line
action:
The doctrine half. vif-3 has already fixed the skill name and path to `verify-app` and `.bee/verify/verify-app/`; use those exact strings. Edit ONLY sources, then `bee dev regen`.

A fence added in slice 1 guards you: `packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/tests/agents_block_render_parity.rs` pins `AGENTS.md`'s bee block byte-for-byte to `packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md`. Edit the block source and skip the regen and that test goes RED. Never hand-edit `AGENTS.md`.

PART A — the feature map joins the read-first rule (per D4 c93a6948).

`packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md` carries the read-first sentence; find it with `rg -n 'is the state layer' packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md` — one hit, `\`docs/knowledge/\` is the state layer: read it first, sync it when` / `behavior changes.` Name the feature map beside it as the SECOND state layer: `.bee/verify/verify-app/features/` — a README index plus one file per user-facing feature, each answering what the feature is, how a user reaches it, how to drive it, and its gotchas.

Two tiers, and say which is which: the index is read at shaping; the ONE matching feature file is read at planning and travels into the execution worker's brief.

The rule must check its own premise. Most repos have no verification skill, so the path names nothing there. AGENTS.md already states the general form of this ('a rule that presupposes an environment fact checks that fact first') — find it with `rg -n 'presupposes an environment fact' packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md` and lean on it rather than inventing a second phrasing. Absent or empty map: proceed, silently, treating the ask as new. Stale map: NOT silent trust — per plan.md Decisions taken 7 the feature file travels with its last-modified date so a reader can judge it.

PART B — the drive's home on the cap proof line (per D5 036e8a79).

Find the proof-by-change-type rule with `rg -n 'agent owns test scope' packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md` — one hit. It is ONE bullet carrying three parenthesised cases: `(code -> related tests green; docs -> parity/pointer checks; behavior -> judge verdict)`. Add a FOURTH case, not a new bullet: a user-facing surface is proven by driving its mapped feature with its evidence attached. No new vocabulary is needed — decision cb7b14b7 already pins `green:live` to 'the real product was driven and its result inspected', which is exactly this. No new door, no new proof tier.

PART C — the three load points.

  - `skills/bee-shaping/SKILL.md` — at the scout/triage step, read the feature map INDEX to answer one question: is this ask a new feature, or a change to one already mapped? This is what stops an agent building a second door to a room that exists.
  - `skills/bee-planning/SKILL.md` — at the Research step, read the ONE matching feature file. Its 'How to get to it' seeds the cell file list; its 'Gotchas' seed the plan risks.
  - `skills/bee-swarming/SKILL.md` — the execution worker's brief carries that feature file, and the cap step names the drive as the proof a user-facing cell runs. Per plan.md Decisions taken 8 this pointer is the half that actually fires: a case in the middle of a long always-loaded contract is text that rots, so the cap step must name it where the proof line is written.

Keep every addition short. These are pointer lines into an existing flow, not new sections.

FINALLY: run `.bee/bin/bee dev regen`, then `.bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check`. Confirm the slice-1 fence is green — it is the direct test of whether the regen happened.
